abstract: The sonographic appearance of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia is nonspecific and also seen in complete or partial hydatidiform mole, hydropic degeneration, degenerating fibroids, or ovarian dysgerminomas. Correlation with the serum human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level may be helpful since levels exceeding 100,000 IU/L are strongly suggestive of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. However, low hCG levels may also be found in the presence of this disease. The authors studied six patients who were suspected of having gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Three of the six proved to have incomplete abortions or molar degeneration. Doppler ultrasound (US) was used to record the signal in the uterine arteries of these patients. The signals were compared with those of three nongravid volunteers and three patients in the first trimester of pregnancy. Analysis of the signals in the uterine artery showed higher systolic and diastolic Doppler shifts in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia when compared with postabortal, gravid, and nongravid signals. These preliminary results indicate that Doppler US has the potential to be clinically useful in the diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の超音波所見は非特異的であり、完全または部分胞状奇胎、水腫様変性、変性筋腫、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫でも認められる。血清hCG値が100,000IU/Lを超える場合は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が強く示唆されるが、低いhCG値でも本疾患が存在しうる。われわれは、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が疑われた6例を検討した。6例中3例は不全流産または胞状変性であった。子宮動脈の信号を記録するためにドプラ超音波検査(US)を用い、その信号を非妊娠ボランティア3例および妊娠初期の患者3例の信号と比較した。子宮動脈の解析では、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍では流産後、妊娠中、非妊娠の信号と比べて収縮期および拡張期のドプラ偏位が高かった。これらの予備的結果は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断においてドプラUSが臨床的に有用である可能性を示している。
